title: Affine RHom of a pseudo-coherent complex is quasi-coherent
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, $U=\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], let $P$ be an object of $D(R)$ [def-pc-derived-category] represented by a bounded-above complex of finite projective $R$-modules, and let $L$ be an object of $D(R)$ represented by a complex whose cohomology vanishes in all sufficiently negative degrees. Then $R\mathcal H om_U(\widetilde P,\widetilde L)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] $\cong\widetilde{R\operatorname{Hom}_R(P,L)}$. Its cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent and vanish in all sufficiently negative degrees.
